originalDsl:
@diagram uml-sequence
User actor as "User"
WebApp participant as "WebApp"
AuthService participant as "AuthService"
UserDB participant as "UserDB"

msg_1 = User -#> WebApp as "submit current and new password"
msg_2 = WebApp -#> AuthService as "request password change"
msg_3 = AuthService -#> UserDB as "verify current password hash"
msg_4 = UserDB -.-> AuthService as "password hash valid"
msg_5 = AuthService -#> UserDB as "store new password hash"
msg_6 = AuthService -.-> WebApp as "password changed confirmation"
msg_7 = WebApp -.-> User as "display success message"

injectedDefects.description: replaced closing quote on label "User" with Unicode look-alike U+201D
